description:
Deliverables:
- Extend from one logical singleton to many keyed singletons on the same runtime model.
- Harden many-key distribution, rebalance fairness, by-node stats, migration limits, and conservative placement behavior on shared storage.

Acceptance:
- Multi-key acceptance proves different nodes can be primary for different keys.
- Rebalancing preserves per-key state.
- Stats and ownership remain deterministic.
title: Harden keyed fleet distribution and rebalance
